H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H7141: Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H3966: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H4885: delight, concretely (the cause or object) or abstractly (the feeling)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H3411: properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess
H6828: properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as aquarter (gloomy and unknown)
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H4869: defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H3259: to fix upon (by agreement or appointment); by implication, to meet (at a stated time), to summon (to trial), to direct (in a certain quarter or position), to engage (for marriage)
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H926: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously
H2648: properly, to start up suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, to fear
H270: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession)
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H3205: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H6921: the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward, for brevity the east wind)
H8659: Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H1819: to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H7130: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
H1964: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H1523: properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H3063: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H5437: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
H5362: to strike with more or less violence (beat, fell, corrode); by implication (of attack) to knock together, i.e. surround or circulate
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H4026: a tower (from its size or height); by analogy, a rostrum; figuratively, a (pyramidal) bed of flowers
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H314: hinder; generally, late or last; specifically (as facing the east) western
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H5090: to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh
H4192: 'To die for the son', probably the title of a popular song
